description.value:
Starting at 1st level, you can materialize floating Notum Valences known as Manifestation Nodes. As an Action, you spend Nanopool points to manifest one node in an unoccupied space within 60 feet. The minimum cost is 2 Nanopool points (Power Level 1), and you can spend additional points up to your Max Power Level (+1 NP per tier).

  • Node Aspects: You choose the node's aspect upon manifestation: Wrath (offensive force), Curative (somatic restoration), or Bewilderment (sensory distortion).
  • Capacity & Duration: You can maintain up to 3 active nodes simultaneously. A manifestation persists for a number of hours equal to your Meta-Physicist level, until reduced to 0 HP, or until you dismiss it.
  • Conduit Pool: All your manifestations share a single Conduit Pool with hit points equal to 10 + (5 * @classes.meta-physicist.levels). Overpowering a manifestation at Power Level 2 or higher immediately heals the Conduit Pool for 5 * Power Level.
  • Noetic Pulse: As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can issue a Noetic Pulse command to one active manifestation node, activating its corresponding action (Wrath Strike, Curative Pulse, or Bewilderment Pulse).
  • Symbiotic Orbit: A manifestation node can enter and occupy an ally's space, moving along with them without provoking opportunity attacks.
